grammar_title: 情态动词综合复习(义务·建议·许可·能力 / 现在推测 / modal + have done)
source: 外研社新标准选择性必修第四册 Unit 6 The Call of the Challenger:情态动词综合复习。句子围绕航天·挑战者号·探索勇气主题,语境强制唯一情态;干扰项为意义不符的情态动词或错误形式(现在式 vs 完成式),答案唯一;零术语、应用型填空。

points.point: 义务 / 建议 / 许可 / 能力(must · have to · should · ought to · may · can · could)
points.overview: 强制必要 → must / have to;建议劝告 → should / ought to;表示许可、被允许 → may / can;表示能力、能够 → can / could / be able to。靠语境(规定、劝告、获准、训练后会做)判断,只有一个情态自然成立。

points.point: 对现在情况的推测(must · may / might / could · can't)
points.overview: 有把握的肯定推断 → must be/do(看得见的证据);否定推断、绝无可能 → can't be/do;没把握的可能 → may / might / could be。语境给出的证据强弱决定用哪一个,且四个选项中只有一个可能性词。

points.point: 对过去的推测与评论(must / can't / should / needn't / could / might + have done)
points.overview: 对过去有把握的肯定 → must have done;绝无可能 → can't have done;本该做却没做(批评/后悔)→ should have done;做了却没必要 → needn't have done;过去本可能(未实现)→ could / might have done。干扰项常是意义相反的情态或漏掉 have 的现在式。

questions.stem: All astronauts ____ pass a strict medical check before any space flight.
questions.explanation: 出发前的硬性规定、必须做到 → 表强制必要的 must。

questions.stem: You look exhausted; you ____ rest well before tomorrow's launch.
questions.explanation: 给对方提建议 → 表建议的 should。

questions.stem: Visitors ____ take photos in the space hall, but they must not touch the models.
questions.explanation: 被允许做某事(获得许可)→ 表许可的 may。

questions.stem: Thanks to months of hard training, she ____ stay calm even in great danger.
questions.explanation: 训练后具备了这种能力 → 表过去能力的 could。

questions.stem: There is no air outside, so astronauts ____ wear a spacesuit when they leave the craft.
questions.explanation: 客观情况逼使、不得不 → 表客观必要的 have to。

questions.stem: With this powerful telescope, we ____ see galaxies billions of light years away.
questions.explanation: 借助望远镜而有此能力 → 表能力的 can。

questions.stem: If you really want to join the programme, you ____ start exercising right now.
questions.explanation: 提出忠告、理应去做 → 表建议的 ought to。

questions.stem: "You ____ enter the control room now," the manager said. "Everything is ready."
questions.explanation: 管理者给予许可 → 表许可的 may。

questions.stem: The rule is strict: every crew member ____ obey the captain's orders at once.
questions.explanation: 严格规定、必须服从 → 表强制的 must。

questions.stem: Students ____ visit the space camp at weekends if they sign up in advance.
questions.explanation: 事先报名便获准前往 → 表许可的 may。

questions.stem: Your hands are shaking; you ____ take a short break before the next test.
questions.explanation: 关心地提建议 → 表建议的 should。

questions.stem: Safety comes first, so the engineers ____ check every part of the rocket twice.
questions.explanation: 安全要求下必须做到 → 表强制必要的 must。

questions.stem: Even as a child, Yang Liwei ____ name many of the stars in the night sky.
questions.explanation: 童年时便具备这种本领 → 表过去能力的 could。

questions.stem: Because water floats away, astronauts ____ add it to most of their food in space.
questions.explanation: 客观条件所迫、不得不 → 表客观必要的 have to。

questions.stem: The application video is due tomorrow; you ____ submit it as soon as possible.
questions.explanation: 理应尽快去做的忠告 → 表建议的 ought to。

questions.stem: Reporters ____ watch the take-off from the special area near the launch site.
questions.explanation: 记者获准在专区观看 → 表许可的 may。

questions.stem: Without enough oxygen, the crew ____ return to the station immediately.
questions.explanation: 紧急情况下必须立刻返回 → 表强制必要的 must。

questions.stem: After years of practice, these pilots ____ land the shuttle even in a storm.
questions.explanation: 长期练习后具备这种能力 → 表能力的 can。

questions.stem: If the weather looks bad, you ____ delay the launch rather than take a risk.
questions.explanation: 给出明智的建议 → 表建议的 should。

questions.stem: Trained for months, the young teacher ____ explain how gravity worked in space.
questions.explanation: 经训练后能够做到 → 表过去能力的 could。

questions.stem: The lights are on and I can hear voices, so the crew ____ be inside the module now.
questions.explanation: 有灯光、有人声为证据 → 有把握的肯定推断 must。

questions.stem: That bright dot ____ be a star; it is moving far too fast across the sky.
questions.explanation: 移动太快、绝不可能是星 → 否定推断 can't。

questions.stem: Scientists are still not sure, but there ____ be simple life on some distant planets.
questions.explanation: 尚不确定的可能性 → 没把握的 might。

questions.stem: She knows every part of the rocket, so she ____ be a real expert.
questions.explanation: 了如指掌为证据 → 有把握的肯定推断 must。

questions.stem: He ____ be in the spacecraft now; I have just seen him in the control room.
questions.explanation: 刚见到他在别处 → 绝无可能的否定推断 can't。

questions.stem: We don't know yet, but a planet like ours ____ have water on its surface.
questions.explanation: 未知的一种可能 → 没把握的 could。

questions.stem: The screen shows the engine is running, so everything ____ be working well.
questions.explanation: 仪表为证 → 有把握的肯定推断 must。

questions.stem: Eric isn't certain, but life out there ____ look quite different from us.
questions.explanation: 不确定的可能 → 没把握的 may。

questions.stem: This ____ be the right answer; the numbers simply do not add up.
questions.explanation: 数字对不上、不可能正确 → 否定推断 can't。

questions.stem: Look at all that smoke and fire — something ____ be seriously wrong.
questions.explanation: 浓烟烈火为证据 → 有把握的肯定推断 must。

questions.stem: Take a coat; the evening at the observatory ____ get rather cold.
questions.explanation: 对入夜可能变冷的推测 → 没把握的 might。

questions.stem: The signal is far too weak; it ____ be coming from a nearby planet.
questions.explanation: 信号太弱、不可能来自近处 → 否定推断 can't。

questions.stem: Her eyes are red and she keeps crying, so she ____ feel terribly sad.
questions.explanation: 红眼、哭泣为证 → 有把握的肯定推断 must。

questions.stem: No one is certain, but dark matter ____ be made of tiny unknown particles.
questions.explanation: 未确定的科学可能 → 没把握的 could。

questions.stem: The telescope cost millions of pounds, so its images ____ be extremely clear.
questions.explanation: 造价昂贵为依据 → 有把握的肯定推断 must。

questions.stem: The launch is not confirmed, but it ____ take place early tomorrow morning.
questions.explanation: 尚未确定的可能 → 没把握的 may。

questions.stem: You ____ be serious; no one could survive in space without a spacesuit.
questions.explanation: 对荒谬说法的否定 → 绝无可能的 can't。

questions.stem: Keep watching the sky tonight; you ____ even catch sight of a shooting star.
questions.explanation: 也许会看到的可能 → 没把握的 might。

questions.stem: All the warning lights are flashing, so the test ____ be about to begin.
questions.explanation: 信号灯闪烁为证据 → 有把握的肯定推断 must。

questions.stem: We aren't sure of the cause, but a small crack ____ be the reason for the leak.
questions.explanation: 未确定的一种可能原因 → 没把握的 could。

questions.stem: The ground is scorched and smoking; the rocket ____ a huge trail of fire.
questions.explanation: 现场痕迹为证 → 对过去有把握的 must have left;must leave 漏掉 have 是现在式,错。

questions.stem: You ____ the oxygen tank earlier; now it is far too late to fix it.
questions.explanation: 本该检查却没检查 → 含批评的 should have checked;should check 是现在式,错。

questions.stem: You ____ so much; the landing went perfectly in the end.
questions.explanation: 担心了却没必要 → needn't have worried;needn't worry 现在式,错。

questions.stem: If she had lived, she ____ a whole new generation of scientists.
questions.explanation: 与过去事实相反、本可能实现却未实现 → might have inspired。

questions.stem: He ____ the comet last night; the sky was completely covered with cloud.
questions.explanation: 满天乌云、不可能看见 → 对过去的否定推断 can't have seen;can't see 现在式,错。

questions.stem: All seven seats are empty, so the crew ____ the shuttle already.
questions.explanation: 座位皆空为证 → 有把握的 must have boarded;must board 现在式,错。

questions.stem: The team ____ the parts more carefully before such a risky flight.
questions.explanation: 本该更仔细检测却没做 → 含批评的 should have tested。

questions.stem: With a little more fuel, the old rocket ____ a much higher orbit.
questions.explanation: 条件具备就本可能达到(未实现)→ could have reached。

questions.stem: Her face is pale and her hands shake; the news ____ her deeply.
questions.explanation: 脸色、发抖为证 → 有把握的 must have shocked;must shock 现在式,错。

questions.stem: You ____ your own water; they gave each of us a full bottle.
questions.explanation: 带了水却没必要 → needn't have brought;needn't bring 现在式,错。

questions.stem: The signal died at noon, so the probe ____ working past midday.
questions.explanation: 信号正午即断、不可能继续工作 → 否定推断 can't have kept。

questions.stem: You ____ us about the storm; we walked straight into it.
questions.explanation: 本该告诉却没告诉 → 含责备的 should have told;should tell 现在式,错。

questions.stem: The lab door is open and the lights are on; someone ____ in early.
questions.explanation: 门开灯亮为证 → 有把握的 must have come;must come 现在式,错。

questions.stem: We were lucky; a small crack like that ____ a terrible accident.
questions.explanation: 本可能酿成大祸(幸而未发生)→ might have caused。

questions.stem: You ____ so fast; the launch was put off by two whole hours.
questions.explanation: 赶得急却没必要 → needn't have hurried;needn't hurry 现在式,错。

questions.stem: She ____ the whole report already; she only began writing an hour ago.
questions.explanation: 刚开始一小时、不可能写完 → 否定推断 can't have finished。

questions.stem: The data shows the engine overheated, so the fault ____ there.
questions.explanation: 数据为证 → 有把握的 must have started;must start 现在式,错。

questions.stem: They ____ to the engineers, who had warned them about the cold weather.
questions.explanation: 本该听劝却没听 → 含批评的 should have listened。

questions.stem: If the rules had been obeyed, the disaster ____ avoided.
questions.explanation: 与过去事实相反、本可以避免 → could have been。

questions.stem: Look how exhausted the trainees are; the test ____ extremely hard.
questions.explanation: 学员精疲力竭为证 → 有把握的 must have been;must be 现在式,错。
